title: Australia pilot evidence-readiness scorecard
warning: These are agent-assigned evidence-readiness scores, not transition outcomes, risk rankings or official statistics. Do not combine them into a public crisis or agency index.

scale.0: No valid source for the construct
scale.2: Baseline estimate may be feasible after access, precision and disclosure checks
scale.3: Repeatable descriptive monitoring is feasible with material limitations
scale.4: Decision-grade causal or action-trigger evidence is feasible

overall_decision.reason: The official evidence supports cohort definitions, modelled exposure and parts of worker-flow and continuity-floor baselining. It does not observe realised AI adoption, work redesign and downstream outcomes together over time.

chain_links.available: Task-level augmentability and automatability mapped to ANZSCO occupations.
chain_links.blocking_gap: Static modelled technical potential cannot establish adoption, timing or harm.
chain_links.minimum_next_evidence: Versioned refresh policy and explicit separation from realised adoption.

chain_links.available: Official business-level AI-use context by industry and size, plus mixed-method JSA evidence.
chain_links.blocking_gap: No recurring occupation by region by time measure of deployment, task, intensity or controls.
chain_links.minimum_next_evidence: Monthly employer-verified occupation-region adoption panel with deployment dates and affected workflows.

chain_links.available: Static skill-demand and profile evidence plus adaptation concepts.
chain_links.blocking_gap: No representative before-and-after task, hours, discretion, training, monitoring and worker-voice panel.
chain_links.minimum_next_evidence: Quarterly matched employer-worker redesign instrument with a pre-deployment baseline.

chain_links.available: Monthly modelled occupation-SA4 employment, short longitudinal worker transitions and annual mobility measures.
chain_links.blocking_gap: The same records do not observe AI adoption or work redesign. NERO is smoothed and must not be aggregated across occupations or regions.
chain_links.minimum_next_evidence: Access and precision validation, separate cohort series and a linkage or credible comparison design.

chain_links.available: GSS household income, housing costs, liquidity and cash-flow problems can potentially be crossed with occupation and SA4 in DataLab.
chain_links.blocking_gap: Cross-sectional, retrospective and likely sparse at fine geography. No current Survey of Income and Housing benchmark or cohort panel.
chain_links.minimum_next_evidence: GSS DataLab cell-feasibility test and a repeated household-resource pulse.

chain_links.available: GSS contains direct cash-flow and service-access indicators for all six floor domains, with domain-specific official context.
chain_links.blocking_gap: Most direct measures are cross-sectional, annual, retrospective, incomplete by jurisdiction or not cohort-linked.
chain_links.minimum_next_evidence: Validated GSS baseline plus a monthly or quarterly cohort continuity-floor pulse.

chain_links.available: Life satisfaction, support, trust, desire for work or hours, barriers and incentives are available as separate proxies.
chain_links.blocking_gap: No validated direct, repeated construct for control, meaningful options, worker voice, time autonomy or ability to refuse.
chain_links.minimum_next_evidence: Co-designed agency module with construct validation, repeated observations and visible component measures.

direct_baseline: GSS mortgage or rent cash-flow failure
repeat_context: AIHW rental stress, social housing and waitlists
continuity_floor.blocking_gap: No timely occupation-linked housing access or forced-move series.

direct_baseline: ABS 2023 food insecurity due to lack of money
repeat_context: ABS monthly household food spending, context only
continuity_floor.blocking_gap: Official direct access measures are lagged, retrospective and not repeatably occupation-region linked.

direct_baseline: GSS unable to heat or cool
repeat_context: AER customer debt, hardship, payment plans, disconnections and reconnections
continuity_floor.blocking_gap: AER excludes Victoria, Western Australia and Northern Territory and has no occupation link.

direct_baseline: GSS car registration or insurance cash-flow failure
repeat_context: ABS monthly household transport spending, context only
continuity_floor.blocking_gap: No recurring national, cohort-linked measure of practical transport access.

direct_baseline: GSS health, hospital or Medicare access difficulty
ABS delayed or missed GP care including due to cost
continuity_floor.blocking_gap: Measures are retrospective and occupation-region feasibility is unverified.

direct_baseline: GSS telephone or internet bill cash-flow failure
continuity_floor.blocking_gap: The ACCC performance programme ended in June 2026 and did not measure unconnected households or affordability.

mandatory_gates.pass_condition: Named statistical, privacy, worker-representation, Indigenous data-governance and floor-domain owners approve the pre-registration.
Approved ABS DataLab access exists for GSS 2025, Longitudinal LFS and Barriers and Incentives, with an output-clearance plan.
mandatory_gates.failure_action: Restrict work to public aggregate context.

mandatory_gates.pass_condition: DataLab metadata confirms ANZOCCD can identify all five scoped unit groups without an undocumented mapping.
Each published occupation-geography cell passes ABS clearance, predeclared unweighted-sample, suppression and relative-standard-error rules.
mandatory_gates.failure_action: Move to a broader geography or suppress. Never impute a green status.

mandatory_gates.pass_condition: Every series declares occupation and geography versions. ANZSCO, OSCA and ASGS concordances are versioned, reviewed and tested.
mandatory_gates.failure_action: STOP trend joins across the break.

mandatory_gates.pass_condition: Automated tests reject joins or comparisons across incompatible units and regenerate every eligible alert denominator from source rows, including boundary months.
mandatory_gates.failure_action: STOP composite calculations and affected displays.

mandatory_gates.pass_condition: Each prospective vintage has a verified UTC publisher timestamp or a conservative first-seen interval whose bounds prove that detector inputs predate release. Calendar-only dates and unbounded intervals remain unknown.
mandatory_gates.failure_action: Exclude the vintage from prospective lead-time claims and record the exact next release-availability observation.

mandatory_gates.pass_condition: Each corroborating measure has audited independent lineage and matches the exact occupation, geography, time window and outcome construct. Labour Force family inputs and broader aggregates are context only.
mandatory_gates.failure_action: Leave the corroboration condition unknown. Do not validate an occupation-SA4 signal with dependent or broader evidence.

mandatory_gates.pass_condition: A household-floor observation directly identifies the scoped occupation cohort. Place-level aggregates are displayed separately and cannot satisfy the cohort condition.
mandatory_gates.failure_action: Leave the cohort-floor condition unknown and show place evidence as context only.

mandatory_gates.pass_condition: Every value resolves to source, table or item, reference period, release, transformation, uncertainty, revision and licence metadata.
User testing shows people can distinguish observed data, conditional inference and proposed action, including exposure versus adoption and association versus causation.
The product cannot rank people or places for coercive action, withdraw services or trigger sanctions from modelled exposure, proxies or sparse cells.
A representative repeated occupation-region adoption and work-redesign source is operational with a pre-deployment baseline.
mandatory_gates.failure_action: Permit descriptive context only. Prohibit causal AI transition claims.

mandatory_gates.pass_condition: Direct worker, household-floor and agency measures recur at a cadence appropriate to the promised response time, with known and acceptable lag.

Any trigger uses independently sourced and scope-compatible measures, declared uncertainty, counterevidence, expiry, human review and predeclared false-positive and false-negative costs. Compare no-alert through decision utility because its precision is undefined.
mandatory_gates.failure_action: Show conditions for deliberation only. Do not fire automated actions.

go_limited_observatory_if: All gates except adoption_redesign_evidence and early_warning_cadence pass
The interface is explicitly labelled baseline and descriptive
Missing chain links remain visible and prevent causal or alert outputs
go_early_warning_if: Prospective validation demonstrates useful warning lead time
Independent review accepts construct validity and error costs
Actions are proportionate, reversible and floor-protecting
stop_if: GSS cannot identify the cohorts at a publishable level
Users systematically confuse exposure with adoption or association with causation
Required uncertainty, provenance or coverage cannot be shown
The proposed use could remove support, target or penalise people
No action can occur within the lag of the signal
